author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We test and review the newly announced Formlabs Form Studio 1, a $700 3D printer that directly competes wtih hobbyist resin printers. After over 300 hours of printing, here's how model miniatures, clear parts, and even flexible rubber prints look up close. Plus, a deep dive into the engineering of the Studio 1 at @Formlabs to learn how they made a comparable printer to the Form 4 at a fraction of the price. 

Form Studio 1 resin 3D printer: https://tidd.ly/3VMM41W
